people.name: Balaam
people.line: A prophet hired to curse Israel but blessed them instead.

people.name: Cain
people.line: Adam and Eve's firstborn son, killed his brother Abel

people.name: Korah
people.line: Levite rebel leader; his descendants became temple servants

translations.web: Woe to them! For they went in the way of Cain, and ran riotously in the error of Balaam for hire, and perished in Korah’s rebellion.
translations.bsb: Woe to them! They have traveled the path of Cain; they have rushed headlong into the error of Balaam; they have perished in Korah’s rebellion.
translations.kjv: Woe unto them! for they have gone in the way of Cain, and ran greedily after the error of Balaam for reward, and perished in the gainsaying of Core.
translations.asv: Woe unto them! For they went in the way of Cain, and ran riotously in the error of Balaam for hire, and perished in the gainsaying of Korah.
